scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w services/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/citizen"
scripts.build: npm run build -w services/api && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/citizen
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w services/api && npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run lint -w apps/citizen
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w services/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/citizen
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit -w services/api && npm run build && npm run test:functional
